description: Bridge conditions is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Ontario | Gouvernement de l'Ontario. All bridges in Ontario are inspected every 2 years using the Ontario Structure Inspection Manual (OSIM) format. The weighted condition of all elements is summarized in the Bridge Condition Index (BCI). More details about the BCI can be found on the Bridge Safety page on the Ministry of Transportation website. Coverage: Government of Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Ontario | Gouvernement de l'Ontario. Its tags are Infrastructure and Transportation, Driving and roads, Government information, Infrastructure et transport, Conduite et routes. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, HTML, XLS. The portal shows 2026-08-12 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
